name: Crate of Bloodforged Ingots
summary: A crate containing bloodforged ingots, a rare and reputedly cursed metal needed to forge the signature weapon of a Blood Knight. It sits stashed away inside the haunted courtyards of Shadowfang Keep.

sections.title: A Cursed Metal
sections.body: Bloodforged ingots are made through a closely guarded, enigmatic technique that yields remarkably resilient metal. Despite its strength, ordinary craftsmen refuse to touch it: rumor insists that any smith daring enough to shape the metal is plagued by a dreadful curse. Due to this dark reputation and the scarcity of smiths willing to handle it, stores of the material are exceptionally hard to come by.

sections.title: Hidden in the Keep
sections.body: A supply of these ingots found its way behind the fortified walls of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Stashed within the courtyard stables, the crate was secured amidst the ruined fortress now overrun by ravenous worgen and the restless dead, making retrieval a perilous ordeal for any aspirant hoping to claim it.

faq.q: What are bloodforged ingots used for?
faq.answer: They are a critical component needed to craft the blood-tempered ranseur, the iconic polearm granted to newly initiated Blood Knight adepts.

faq.q: Why is bloodforged metal so scarce?
faq.answer: The crafting process is a tightly guarded secret, and widespread rumors claim that any blacksmith who works the metal is afflicted by a lingering curse, driving most artisans away.

aliases: where is crate of bloodforged ingots
faq.answer: The crate is located inside the courtyard stables of Shadowfang Keep, deep within the territory of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: Initiates aspiring to rise as full Blood Knights must venture into cursed territories like Shadowfang Keep to gather these ingots for their ranseur.
Though extraordinary in resilience, working bloodforged metal carries dire superstitions that keep sensible smiths from ever handling an ingot.
